items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I had gotten him a job playing bass in the band. He left with us.

ctx.x: Oh, Edgar -- we were kids, say the oldest of us was about 16 and he was in his 20's, you know. Emery and Edgar Henry Green was in his 30's or maybe near 40, he was a much older guy. But then Melvin Saunders the little fellow, the drummer, he was so young that we had to leave him off and we got an older drummer named Carl Shelton. He was a tap dancer and a drummer.

We played around the state there for quite a bit and played all the dances and things, after school, of course, and on weekends. In 1926 Edgar got a job playing for Miss Nebraska. Every year at that time -- I don't know if they still have it, they have an international beauty contest in Galveston, Texas. And all of the beauty queens of each state, they'd go there to compete.
